name: seis-release-readiness
description: Honest local release-readiness report from recorded checks and repository metadata.

interface.shortDescription: Report release evidence without claiming a release.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic local SEIS release gate that reads project metadata and optional recorded check results, then separates passed, failed, skipped, and unavailable evidence without publishing or deploying anything.
defaultPrompt: Separate passed, failed, and skipped checks.
Prepare a release gate without deploying.
